title: The full PDE graph energy retains electric-current and pointwise radial-coefficient leakage

leakage.lifted_field: For a smooth full solution psi_n=Q^n phi obeys the covariant matter equation with potential lambda||phi||^2 because Q commutes with D_mu and the radial scalar.
leakage.functional: F_n^PDE is the covariant quadratic energy of psi_n plus (lambda/2) integral ||phi||^2||psi_n||^2.
leakage.exact_identity: dF_n^PDE/dt=integral E dot j_n dx +(lambda/2)integral partial_t||phi||^2 ||Q^n phi||^2 dx.
leakage.homogeneous_restriction: On K1409's slice E=j_n=0 and ||phi||^2 is spatially constant, so the identity reduces exactly to K1411.
leakage.first_full_pde_defect: The single Maxwell equation cancels only the n=0 physical current; for n>0 the lifted electric-current work remains.
leakage.second_full_pde_defect: Base energy does not bound partial_t||phi||^2 in L-infinity_x, so the pointwise radial coefficient cannot be inserted into K1411's scalar Gronwall unchanged.
leakage.boundary: Direct promotion of K1411 is excluded, but gauge-covariant null forms, spacetime estimates, nonlinear normal-form corrections and summable infinite hierarchies remain open.
